\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-13},
  title = {The feedback endpoint is reachable only inside the Compose network},
  date = {2026-09-23},
  milestone = {M6: Monitoring},
  topic = {API Design, Monitoring},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {\texttt{POST /\allowbreak{}feedback} (FR-10) stays.
It takes a request ID and an observed price, and FR-14 joins these delayed labels to the prediction log to report the real error and the interval coverage.
A reverse proxy refuses the endpoint from outside, so only the replay job reaches it; the API key stays as a second layer.
NFR-09 therefore needs no TLS.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item A public endpoint protected by the API key alone: the key would travel in cleartext unless the VM gets TLS, which its NAT setup probably does not allow.
\item No endpoint, the drift job reads the \texttt{ES} prices from the artefact: least code, but ground truth never enters the system through an interface.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} Without labels the monitoring shows only that the inputs changed.
With them it shows the error rising and the intervals losing coverage, which is what M6 grades and the stronger trigger for retraining.
An internal endpoint removes an unverified assumption about TLS on the VM.},
